player.name: Bobo
player.silhouette: Round brown bear with blue eyes and a tiny golden heart-crown; readable at 32px

modes.loopLink: The repaint-the-rainbow loop has no natural end; endless mode lets the speed ramp carry the session to the 90s budget.
modes.name: endless

powerups.loopLink: Rewards precise catches with a score burst, sharpening the core catch loop without adding inputs.
powerups.name: golden heart bonus points

plot: Bobo the Bear Prince catches falling hearts to repaint the fading rainbow so the kitten can cross.

premise.statement: The rainbow is fading and the kitten can't cross to visit — a small, fixable sadness.

strategy.coreLoop: Slide Bobo along the bottom of the sky to catch falling hearts; every 2 hearts repaints one band of the fading rainbow.

twist.assumption: Catching falling hearts just scores points, like any catcher game.
twist.reinterpretation: Every 2 hearts repaints one band of the fading rainbow itself — misses don't just cost points, they dim the world the kitten needs to cross.

background.description: Light-blue sky (#8ecae6) over a meadow with the rainbow arching across the middle

lose.condition: Miss 3 hearts and the run ends

winLose.scoring: Hearts add score with a combo multiplier up to 5x; score accumulates across LVs and the LV is posted to the leaderboard.

win.condition: Catch 12 hearts to repaint all 6 rainbow bands so the kitten can cross
